Pytest unit tests for LateFeeCalculator

These tests cover the major branches: injected vs default today, zero/non-positive balances, grace-period behavior, weekday-only counting, minimum fee enforcement, round-half-up behavior, and the maximum cap. Assuming the class lives in late_fee_calculator.py, this test module should clear >90% branch coverage.

If the class is in a different module, only change the import line.

Test module

from datetime import date

import pytest

from late_fee_calculator import LateFeeCalculator


def test_init_uses_provided_today():
    custom_today = date(2024, 1, 31)

    calc = LateFeeCalculator(today=custom_today)

    assert calc._today == custom_today


def test_init_defaults_today_to_current_date():
    calc = LateFeeCalculator()

    assert calc._today == date.today()


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("start", "end"),
    [
        (date(2024, 1, 10), date(2024, 1, 10)),
        (date(2024, 1, 10), date(2024, 1, 9)),
    ],
)
def test_weekday_days_between_returns_zero_when_end_is_not_after_start(start, end):
    calc = LateFeeCalculator(today=date(2024, 1, 31))

    assert calc._weekday_days_between(start, end) == 0


def test_weekday_days_between_counts_only_weekdays():
    calc = LateFeeCalculator(today=date(2024, 1, 31))

    # Fri -> Tue counts Fri and Mon, but skips Sat/Sun.
    assert calc._weekday_days_between(date(2024, 1, 5), date(2024, 1, 9)) == 2


def test_compute_fee_is_zero_for_non_positive_balance():
    calc = LateFeeCalculator(today=date(2024, 1, 31))

    assert calc.compute_fee_cents(0, date(2024, 1, 1)) == 0
    assert calc.compute_fee_cents(-100, date(2024, 1, 1)) == 0


def test_compute_fee_is_zero_at_grace_period_boundary():
    calc = LateFeeCalculator(today=date(2024, 1, 15))

    # 10 weekdays from Jan 1, 2024 to Jan 15, 2024 -> still within grace period.
    assert calc.compute_fee_cents(10_000, date(2024, 1, 1)) == 0


def test_compute_fee_applies_minimum_fee_once_past_grace(monkeypatch):
    calc = LateFeeCalculator(today=date(2024, 1, 31))
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        calc,
        "_weekday_days_between",
        lambda start, end: calc.GRACE_DAYS + 1,
    )

    assert calc.compute_fee_cents(10_000, date(2024, 1, 1)) == 500


def test_compute_fee_rounds_half_up_for_fractional_cents(monkeypatch):
    calc = LateFeeCalculator(today=date(2024, 1, 31))
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        calc,
        "_weekday_days_between",
        lambda start, end: calc.GRACE_DAYS + 11,
    )

    # raw_fee = 91_000 * (0.015 / 30) * 11 = 500.5 -> rounds to 501
    assert calc.compute_fee_cents(91_000, date(2024, 1, 1)) == 501


def test_compute_fee_applies_maximum_fee_cap(monkeypatch):
    calc = LateFeeCalculator(today=date(2024, 1, 31))
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        calc,
        "_weekday_days_between",
        lambda start, end: calc.GRACE_DAYS + 600,
    )

    # Raw fee exceeds 25% cap, so result should be capped at 2,500 cents.
    assert calc.compute_fee_cents(10_000, date(2024, 1, 1)) == 2_500
